set.body: Add the dependency-free locus-kernel crossProject with SpaceKey, FiniteSpace, existential runtime spaces, Point, Region, Selection, TotalMap, and checked injection, surjection, and bijection evidence. Acceptance follows phase 1 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md: benchmark private region storage, enforce runtime and phantom space identity, preserve explicit ordering, prove Boolean and indexed-logic laws on JVM and Scala.js, and keep public primitive-array ownership defensive.
set.title: Locus 1: finite spaces, regions, selections, and exact maps
